question: How is the great goddess characterized in this invocation?
premises: The goddess is addressed as consisting of darkness.
She is called the great goddess.
She is associated with the great god and praised as well-vowed.
inference: The invocation characterizes the goddess as dark, great, and well-vowed, associated with the great god.
plain_english: Oṃ, O goddess consisting of darkness, O great goddess of the great god, O well-vowed one.
